1050.description:
The future is inevitable! We hurl ourselves towards it like falling raindrops to the Great Sea.

But perhaps, by studying the past, we can know what to expect and be better prepared for the unknown.

Before dire troubles fell upon Lordaeron, there was a bastion of knowledge tucked away in the Tirisfal Glades. It is rumored that a book called Mythology of the Titans was housed in the library of the old Monastery.

Bring it to me and perhaps together we can unlock the secrets of the past!
1050.objectiveText: Retrieve Mythology of the Titans from the Monastery and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge.
1050.title: Mythology of the Titans

1274.description:
Excuse me, sir. Bishop DeLavey asked me to approach adventurers that might be able to help him with a delicate matter.

If you could quietly head to Stormwind Keep and speak to him at your earliest convenience, I'm sure he would appreciate your help. Again, please be discreet. It is a matter of some importance.
1274.objectiveText: Find Bishop DeLavey in Stormwind Keep.
1274.title: The Missing Diplomat

15.completionText: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine.  No good can come of this.  Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again.  I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
15.description:
<name>, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
15.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
15.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

1598.completionText:
Excellent... I was never able to gain access to this text, it was held in a protected wing of the library that would have looked suspicious for me to be loitering around.

Well, you did a good job in getting this, and I'm convinced that you can probably handle your own imp, so there's no reason for me not to show you how to summon one.
1598.description:
You there! <name>, right?

I hope you're sure about becoming a warlock, because if you can't hold your own, you're likely to get pulled under.

I'm to teach you, but I need to make sure you're strong enough first.

There was a novice studying at the Abbey who ran off to join the Defias Brotherhood. Why do I care? Well, he stole some important books.

One of those happens to be a book I've wanted for myself, the Powers of the Void. Steal it for me, they have it hidden at their tent in the Vineyards.
1598.objectiveText: Retrieve the Powers of the Void for Drusilla La Salle.
1598.progressText: It was too conspicuous for me to steal the book myself. What luck one of their own patsies did the dirty work for me.
1598.title: The Stolen Tome

18.completionText: Back with some bandanas, I see.  The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
18.description:
Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
18.objectiveText: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
18.progressText: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

21.completionText: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army.  There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them.  We have further tasks for you.
21.description:
Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.

Waste no time, <name>.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
21.objectiveText: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.
21.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

2158.completionText:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
2158.description:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
2158.objectiveText: Speak with Innkeeper Farley at the Lion's Pride Inn.
2158.title: Rest and Relaxation

2745.description:
Hmm, an interesting tale, and not one to be taken lightly. Yeah, I can help you, but what you need to do is divvy out a form of justice that's not... legal, if you're to see this through to the end.

Lescovar and Marzon need to be dealt with, and swiftly. Do you think you're capable of such a thing?

You decide. If so, then make haste to the castle and find an old friend of mine, a gnome named Tyrion. He's been watching Lescovar now for a couple weeks. He should be able to help you end this.
2745.objectiveText: Speak to Tyrion in Stormwind Castle.
2745.title: Infiltrating the Castle

279.completionText:
Ah, well done <name>.

Accept this as payment for fulfillment of your contract with the Merchant Marines.
279.description:
Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline.  They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.

One of these Murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other Bluegill Murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby Murloc hovels.  Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.

Gobbler prowls the river inlet north of here.  Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
279.objectiveText:
Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs.

Slay Gobbler and take his head.

Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
279.progressText: Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those Murlocs.
279.title: Claws from the Deep

281.completionText:
This crate is covered with clawed scratches, and the marks of water damage.  Prying it open reveals soggy and rotted straw, as if something of value was stored in the crate.  You search through the straw...

...and find an armload of red-colored bottles.
281.description:
Not long ago a merchant vessel, the Blind Princess, was raided by Murlocs.  Although the ship escaped intact, much of its cargo was dragged overboard by the creatures, including a very valuable statuette of Terenas Menethil.  We want that statuette recovered.

Search the coastal Murloc hovels for crates, barrels and other evidence of lost cargo.  Find the Menethil Statuette and return it to me.
281.objectiveText: Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.
281.title: Reclaiming Goods

284.completionText:
This barrel is largely untouched.  Prying it open...

...you are assaulted by the pungent odor of cheese.  It's a little wet, but still tasty!
284.description:
You thoroughly search this cluster of Murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.

Perhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.
284.title: The Search Continues

285.completionText: This barrel is halfway buried amidst the mud and grass ...
285.description:
This grouping of Murloc hovels, after a thorough inspection, reveals nothing.

...but you're certain that the next clue you find will be fruitful.

One of the hovels to the north must have the Menethil Statuette!
285.objectiveText: Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.
285.title: Search More Hovels

286.completionText:
The captain of the Blind Princess will be relieved to hear this precious cargo has been recovered.  You have well earned this payment for services rendered.

It is good to see dependable folk like you, especially in trying times such as these.
286.description:
After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw.  It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.

This must be the Menethil Statuette!  You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
286.objectiveText: Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.

objectives.text: Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.

286.title: Return the Statuette

288.completionText: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!
288.progressText: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
288.title: The Third Fleet

289.completionText: My thanks to you, <name>. And the gratitude of my cursed brethren goes to you as well.
289.description:
<Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...>

I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.

But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
289.objectiveText: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig. Bring Snellig's Snuffbox to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor.
289.progressText: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good sir, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
289.title: The Cursed Crew

290.description:
To break the curse and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.

My old captain is still in my dreams. I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.

Then, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.
290.objectiveText:
Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor.

Use the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.
290.title: Lifting the Curse

294.description:
The situation is severe, that much is for sure. When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors. These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.

Help clear the Wetlands of these Raptors, <name>. Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there. Kill 10 of each, if you can.

That will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.
294.objectiveText: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill 10 Mottled Screechers and 10 Mottled Raptors.
294.title: Ormer's Revenge

299.description:
Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy."

I fear we are running out of time. I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. But you are strong.

Scour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!
299.objectiveText: Prospector Whelgar wants you to scour the excavation site in search of the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru.
299.title: Uncovering the Past

303.description:
War rages both home and abroad. While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the Alliance, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron Dwarves.  They laid waste to the Thandol Span. Dun Modr fell soon after.

We need you to gather force and push the front back.  If you can kill 15 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.

Now make haste!
303.objectiveText: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 15 Dark Iron Dwarves,  5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.
303.title: The Dark Iron War

304.description:
Many of my soldiers died in the battle of Dun Modr.  My own brother perished when the West Bridge over the Thandol Span was destroyed.  Aye, the Dark Iron dwarves are a devilish breed.  From what Roggo was able to gather, the leader of this band of thugs in the Wetlands is a warlock named Balgaras the Foul.  He is quite a coward however.  He sends his soldiers to do his bidding but stays elusive, avoiding danger.

If you can find the spineless scum, slay him and bring me his ear.  I will reward you, paladin.
304.objectiveText: Kill Balgaras the Foul and bring his ear to Longbraid the Grim outside of Dun Modr.
304.progressText: Were you able to locate Balgaras the Foul yet, paladin?  He has been evading us for quite some time.
304.title: A Grim Task

305.completionText: Oh, thank the heavens you are here!
305.description:
You cannot imagine how worried I have been.

My wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. Surely something is wrong!

Longbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. I assume that scout is you, <name>. Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!
305.objectiveText: Tarrel Rockweaver wants you to travel to the Excavation Site and contact Merrin Rockweaver.
305.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306.description:
It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.

Before we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.

Ormer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.

Here, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.
306.objectiveText: Return to Tarrel Rockweaver with Merrin's note.

objectives.text: Return to Tarrel Rockweaver with Merrin's note.

306.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

3102.completionText:
You're gonna find a number of outfits that covet our skills, <name>. Adventurers, SI:7... heck, even the Defias Brotherhood wouldn't mind a spy or two inside Stormwind. But you remember this, you're your own woman. Don't let nobody bully you into doing something you don't wanna do! Besides, we hold all the cards... at least, we do before the game's done. Know what I mean?

Anyway, just wanted to introduce myself and let you know that I'm here if you need any training. Come by anytime.
3102.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Jorik, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3102.objectiveText: Read the Encrypted Letter and speak to Jorik Kerridan in the stable behind Northshire Abbey.

objectives.text: Read the Encrypted Letter and speak to Jorik Kerridan in the stable behind Northshire Abbey.

3102.progressText:
You made it here in one piece, and it doesn't look like too many people saw you. Good enough for me. I don't like to have much attention drawn to me back here... nice and quiet. I'm sure you can understand.

Have any trouble yet? I'm glad to hear not. That'll change soon enough.
3102.title: Encrypted Letter

3105.completionText:
As you grow in power, you will be tempted--you must always remember to control yourself. I will not lie--corruption can come to any practitioner of the arcane; especially one who deals with creatures from the Twisting Nether. Be patient, and be prudent... but do not let that repress your ambition.

As you grow more powerful, return to me and I will teach you more about our ways.
3105.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Drusilla, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3105.objectiveText: Read the Tainted Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle next to Northshire Abbey.

objectives.text: Read the Tainted Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle next to Northshire Abbey.

3105.progressText: Ah, so you've arrived, and not a moment too soon, <name>. Some of the guards were over here a moment ago and were giving me curious looks... pathetic mundanes.
3105.title: Tainted Letter

33.completionText:
You've been busy!  I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
33.description:
I hate those nasty timber wolves!  But I sure like eating wolf steaks...  Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.

Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.
33.objectiveText: Bring 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat to Eagan Peltskinner outside Northshire Abbey.
33.progressText: Hey <name>.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33.title: Wolves Across the Border

350.completionText:
You're kidding? Shaw wants my help again? Of all the nerve...

The Defias Brotherhood, you say? Well, you're certainly the bearer of wonderful news, aren't you? Next you're going to tell me that Deathwing is still alive and attacking the city.

All right, tell me everything from the beginning. And don't leave out something you think might not be important. I need to know it all.
350.description:
That Marzon would be contacting a member of the Defias and have ties to Lescovar...

Having killed VanCleef and Thredd, it would be hard to see Lescovar brought to proper justice, as your evidence is nothing without their testimonies. That is not even considering the fact that Lescovar is a noble and well connected. It effectively makes him above the law.

You'll need other help. I loathe to do so, but there is someone I know that will aid us. You'll find Trias in the Trade District of the city.
350.objectiveText: Speak to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
350.title: Look to an Old Friend

3903.completionText:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903.description:
You've shown yourself a dependable warlock, <name>.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
3903.title: Milly Osworth

3904.completionText:
Oh thank you, <name>!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
3904.description:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904.objectiveText: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.
3904.title: Milly's Harvest

3905.completionText:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, <name>, and keep you safe!
3905.description:
Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
3905.objectiveText: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

objectives.text: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

3905.progressText: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905.title: Grape Manifest

393.completionText:
What? What's this? Yes, I think I do know who this man is, but his name is not Maelik. Assassins wear many names and many masks, discarding them as they lose their usefulness. Another alias known to be used by this man is Marzon; though even that is surely not his true name.

Regardless, he is an assassin and I know a good deal about him.

Marzon is currently under the employ of Lord Gregor Lescovar, a lord of shady reputation, even given the corruption of the nobility of Stormwind.

objectives.text: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

393.progressText: Greetings. Of what service can I be to you, paladin?
393.title: Shadow of the Past

464.description:
The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.

Now they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.

We want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.
464.objectiveText: Bring 8 Dragonmaw War Banners to Captain Stoutfist.
464.title: War Banners

47.description:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
47.objectiveText: Bring 10 Gold Dust to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.  Gold Dust is gathered from Kobolds in Elwynn Forest.
47.title: Gold Dust Exchange

470.completionText:
Oh, thank you, <name>! I was afraid that it was lost for good!

<She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.>

Hm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.
470.description:
On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.

I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.

The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!

I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!
470.objectiveText: One of the oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb has Sida's bag, retrieve it and bring it back to her in Menethil Harbor.
470.title: Digging Through the Ooze

471.description:
I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.

Midwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!

...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.
471.objectiveText: Collect 6 Giant Crocolisk Skins and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
471.title: Apprentice's Duties

472.completionText:
What brave paladin sends word from Menethil?  Ah <name>, they call you.

You bring hope to a hopeless situation.  'Tis good news indeed that young Harlo survived.  While fleeing he received a grievous wound.  We had but little time to send him on his way on the back of the only surviving steed with the regiment.

But now we face a perilous situation.  Dun Modr has fallen and we are but a shadow of the great regiment we once were.
472.description:
Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!

My wounds are grave, paladin.  Most of the regiment was killed!  The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.

Our leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn.  As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back.  All went black.

I awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers.  Hope still burns within me.  Perhaps Longbraid is still alive!  See if you can find him near Dun Modr, human!
472.objectiveText: Search for Longbraid near the town of Dun Modr.
472.title: Fall of Dun Modr

484.completionText: Nice work you've done here, <name>. The quality of these skins is superb. I'll have to get them into the curing process as soon as possible. Oh, but before I get to that, there's some other work I need done that I think you might be able to take care of.
484.description:
I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.

Met Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.

I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.

Being that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the waters right outside of town.
484.objectiveText: Obtain 6 Young Crocolisk Skins for James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
484.progressText: <name>, right? Do you have my skins?
484.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

5261.completionText: That's true.  I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves!  Are you that person?
5261.description:
Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him.  That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.

If you're interested then speak with Eagan.  He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.
5261.title: Eagan Peltskinner

536.description:
Transferred from the Stormwind city guard to Southshore, a town that should be abandoned by the looks of it... Smell of the harbor day and night.

Not to mention ol' Redpath... Wants me to take care of the murlocs. Ha! 

I can barely rouse myself to go out to some of the pockets of the overgrown fish down the Western Strand. If you would go in my place and take care of them, I'd appreciate it.
536.objectiveText: Kill 10 Torn Fin Tidehunters and 10 Torn Fin Oracles for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.
536.title: Down the Coast

54.completionText:
Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.

And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
54.description:
<name>, you are a warlock with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
54.objectiveText: Take Marshal McBride's Documents to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

objectives.text: Take Marshal McBride's Documents to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

54.progressText:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54.title: Report to Goldshire

555.description:
If there's one thing you'll learn about Southshore it's that we have some of the best cuisine north of Stormwind!

Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks to travel from as far as Darkshire just to enjoy a bowl.  Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head up past Dalaran to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt Snapjaws but it's just too dangerous now. If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the Snapjaws up north and Soothing Spices, I'll whip some up!
555.objectiveText: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Chef Jessen in Southshore.
555.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

6.completionText: Hah - you caught him!  You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
6.description:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, <name>.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6.objectiveText: Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.
6.progressText: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

62.description:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62.objectiveText: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
62.title: The Fargodeep Mine

631.description:
A tremendous explosion roared through the hills. 'Twas horrible, I tell you!

Good soldiers died defending the Thandol Span. Longbraid says we'll take revenge on the Dark Irons before all is said and done.

We're in a world of hurt though and I don't see any reinforcements in sight. Longbraid sent Ol' Rustlocke to scout the eastern bridge to see if we could secure it.

That was days ago. We haven't the manpower to search for him with Dun Modr under siege.

Perhaps you can find him...
631.objectiveText: Rhag Garmason wants you to locate Ol' Rustlocke.
631.title: The Thandol Span

7.completionText:
Well done, citizen.  Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us.  And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
7.description: Your first task is one of cleansing, <name>.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
7.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
7.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

783.completionText:
Ah, good.  Another volunteer.  We're getting a lot of you these days.

I hope it's enough.

The human lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad.  This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.

It is a many-fronted battle we wage, <name>.  Gird yourself for a long campaign.
783.description:
I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young warlock, because there is work to do here in Northshire.

And I don't mean farming.

The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close.  And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home.  And their alliance.

If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride.  He's inside the abbey behind me.
783.title: A Threat Within

88756.description:
The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
88756.objectiveText: Retrieve 3 Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.
88756.title: Bring Back a Bang

91736.completionText: The machine dispenses a clear liquid into a bottle...
91736.progressText: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.
91736.title: Applejack Still

91741.completionText:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
91741.description:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741.objectiveText: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

objectives.text: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

91741.progressText: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743.completionText:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.objectiveText: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.progressText: Have you rescued my books yet, <name>?!
91743.title: Rascally Rodents

91745.completionText: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
91745.description: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745.objectiveText: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
91745.title: Mining Consultant

91752.completionText:
Thank you for returning these stolen books, <name>. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.

You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
91752.description:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752.objectiveText: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
91752.progressText: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752.title: The Big Picture

91758.completionText: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.
91758.description:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.objectiveText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
91758.title: Follow That Kobold!

91772.completionText:
What's this, <name>? Tracking kobolds?

Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.

Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
91772.description:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772.objectiveText: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
91772.progressText: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775.description:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.objectiveText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
91775.title: Book Return

92124.completionText:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.
92124.description:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124.objectiveText: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
92124.title: Book Inventory

943.description:
Prospector Whelgar now holds the original fossil at his site in the Wetlands. When I discovered the Stone of Relu, I believed it to be the key to unlocking the mystery of the fossil.

While I traveled on the road to meet Whelgar, I was attacked by raptors and the relic was lost. I don't know which one of the mottled beasts swallowed the relic but if you can retrieve it, I can unleash the power of these artifacts.

Bring me both the Stone of Relu, and the original fossil he holds.
943.objectiveText: Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil Harbor wants you to bring him the Stone of Relu and Flagongut's Fossil.
943.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

95647.completionText: I thought we were done for! Something upset the wildlife around here and our excavation team was overwhelmed. Thank you for helping us with those spiders.

objectives.text: Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman

95647.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95772.completionText: This dwarf bears a striking resemblance to Dorin Songblade. The gun in his hands has the letters "DLS" carved into the stock.
95772.title: Songblade Search

95795.description:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795.title: Fallen in the Fen

95809.completionText:
Goodness, that sounds terrible!

By the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.

<She holds the reed-woven heart to her own.>

I'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.
95809.description:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809.objectiveText: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

objectives.text: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

95809.progressText: I'm more than worried about him!
95809.title: Heartwoven

95810.completionText:
Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there. 

Well, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.
95810.description:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810.objectiveText: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands excavation site.
95810.title: Lost Relic Carry

95998.completionText: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
95998.description:
Well howdy there, warlock. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998.objectiveText: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
95998.title: The Great Outdoors

96626.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, warlock. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626.objectiveText: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Tomas in Goldshire

96626.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627.completionText:
I appreciate the lookin' out, warlock. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96627.description:
<name>, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627.objectiveText: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
96627.title: The Adventurer

97921.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97921.objectiveText: Speak with Herbalist Pomeroy in Elwynn Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97921.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

98189.completionText: You managed to get it back from those monsters! There aren't too many artifacts of the late king left now.
98189.description:
My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
98189.objectiveText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

objectives.text: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

98189.progressText: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189.title: Return the Statuette

98190.completionText: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.
98190.description:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, lad. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190.objectiveText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

objectives.text: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

98190.progressText: Let us speak, paladin. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190.title: A Friend of the Family

98191.completionText:
By the Light... it looks just like his boy...

<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>

This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.

It is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.

Thank you, paladin. Light bless you.
98191.description:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191.objectiveText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.

objectives.text: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.

98191.progressText: Light be with you, paladin. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191.title: A Friend of the Family

98197.description:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197.objectiveText: Recover 6 Khaz Modan Timber and 30 Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.
98197.progressText: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197.title: Spoils of War

98208.description:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
98208.objectiveText: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.
98208.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98219.completionText: Ah, of course. Another one of Stormwind's finest here to check on me. Same as last month!
98219.description:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, <name>.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219.objectiveText: Speak to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
98219.title: The Shamed Lieutenant

98221.description:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221.objectiveText: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.
98221.title: From the Ashes

98245.description:
I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.
98245.objectiveText: Collect 10 Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather.
98245.title: Razormaw Needling

98246.description:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
98246.objectiveText: Gather 12 Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.
98246.title: Trying Times

98282.description:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282.objectiveText: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
98282.title: Alchemical Hazards

98463.description:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
98463.objectiveText: Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.
98463.title: Talk of the Town

98815.description:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?

I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
98815.objectiveText: Return 4 Thicket Raptor Hides to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.
98815.title: Highland Hides

98824.completionText:
What's this you've got...

Woah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.

You've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.

We'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.
98824.description:
With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.

I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by <name>! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.

High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.

Good find!
98824.objectiveText: Bring the Titan Relic to High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

objectives.text: Bring the Titan Relic to High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

98824.progressText: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.
98824.title: Prehistoric Prism
